sources.title: Emirates travel requirements — Afghanistan

sources.officialityEvidence: The live UAE MOFA Emirati-traveller page separately presents the Normal UAE passport category and the destination-specific travel restriction.

sources.title: Emirates travel requirements — Côte d'Ivoire

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure

policies.title: United Arab Emirates ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: UAE MOFA directly places the Normal Emirati passport in Côte d'Ivoire's electronic preapproval route; the state-approved process prints and issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Use a Normal UAE passport and complete Côte d'Ivoire's approved ordinary-passport pre-enrolment before travel, including its stated supporting documents and authority approval.
Board with the approved pre-enrolment response, then complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.
This is preapproved border issuance, not an electronically issued visa; work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the Normal UAE passport pre-enrolment and the service's required documents before travel.
Wait for the approved authority response before boarding for Abidjan.
Present the approval at the airport and complete biometric enrolment for visa printing and issuance.

conflicts.explanation: The direct Normal-passport route requires preapproval, but Côte d'Ivoire prints and issues the visa at Abidjan airport rather than electronically before travel.

unresolved.reason: UAE MOFA says UAE citizens are not allowed to travel to Afghanistan. The restriction does not establish an ordinary short-visitor issuance route or a normalizable taxonomy status.

UAE MOFA's Normal-passport visa-required label and generic eVisa link do not establish an ordinary Emirati-passport eligibility or issuance result.
